name: Suzlon Energy Limited
remarksWeb: (1) Out of the total 1,11,45,826 partly paid-up shares shown above in column V, the Company has received first and final call money on 29,51,763 shares and accordingly has obtained listing permission for the same from Stock Exchanges. The paid-up capital as on March 31, 2024, includes 29,51,763 shares as fully paid up since call money has been paid on these shares. (3) The voting rights are considered in proportion to the amount paid-up on the face value of the shares, i.e. Fully paid-up shares x Rs.2 and Partly paid-up shares x Re.1.
